mgmt_bio.text: Christophe Fouquet is President and CEO of ASML, having joined the company in 2008 and worked his way up through several management roles in marketing and product management, including EVP of Applications from 2013 to 2018, EVP of EUV from 2018 to 2022 and Chief Business Officer from 2022 to 2024. Before ASML, he worked at industry peers KLA Tencor and Applied Materials. A physicist by training, he sits atop a leadership team dominated by engineers and long-tenured executives with decades of accumulated technical knowledge, alongside CFO Roger Dassen, who comes from a pure finance and audit background at Deloitte. Under this team, capital allocation prioritizes reinvestment in the business, with R&D treated as sacrosanct, followed by returns to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
